hero.caption:
I decided to walk in Scioto Trail State Park south of Chillicothe, Ohio on this warm afternoon.  I also decided to photograph this log structure which I'd bypassed during previous visits. 
It's a replica of the first Presbyterian church built in the 
area. According to data I found online, it was opened in 1798.

"This plain log structure gives testimony to the simple lifestyle of early Ohioans."--quoting the park website.
